1.title: Drop a file
1.body: Drag it in, click to browse, or paste from your clipboard. It is read straight from your disk into this tab.

2.title: Adjust and preview
2.body: Every change renders live on this device in a background worker. The size readout shows the result before you export.

3.title: Download
3.body: Save the result straight to your downloads. Nothing was uploaded; close the tab and it is gone.

privacy.a: No. {tool} runs entirely in your browser with Web Workers and WebAssembly. Your files never leave your device, and Lokal has no servers that could receive them.

offline.a: Yes. Once a tool has loaded, it keeps working without a connection, and you can install Lokal as an app for quick access.

limits.a: The only limit is your device's memory. Very large files may be slow on older phones; the tool warns you when a file exceeds its recommended size.

cost.a: Yes, free, with no sign-up and no ads. Every tool is free to use as much as you like.

formats.a: {formats}. Support depends on what your browser can decode; the tool tells you right away if a file can't be opened.
